how_generated: 400 tokens; the 16-candidate tournament runs at a randomly chosen 42% of positions and the remaining positions are drawn uniformly (random.Random(seed=3103)). Models text that is only partly machine generated, which is what lands the mean-g between the thresholds.
why_it_matters: Long partly-marked text. Length removes the excuse that the ambiguity is small-sample noise: the signal really is intermediate, and more tokens will not resolve it.
